column1: # D6RF10 PLATEAU EVIDENCE — measured p_first_uncorrected series (the BINDING field, T25)
# Purpose: demonstrate p_first_uncorrected is flat/plateaued by ~300 outer iterations,
#   so B-300 (endTime 300 on R2/R3/R4) measures the SAME converged value as endTime 2000/2500
#   and is verdict-preserving (does not make a PASS easier or a FAIL harder to avoid).
# Source (measured, extracted 2026-09-09 by dafoam-supervisor, §3 check-3, at the artifact):
# Extraction matches the frozen grader d6rf9_grade.py:305-312: per outer-iteration (Time = N) block,
#   p_first_uncorrected = the FIRST 'p initRes:' line in that block. Print cadence 100 outer iters.
# Accept floor CONV_BAR = 1.0e-05 (T25, byte-identical control md5 c6e63098). PASS iff value < floor.
# R2 partial (killed rc=124 at the 855s deadline near Time 250) — corroboration only, tracks R1:
#   value@2500 = 1.62552088e-05 (ratio 1.6255, GATE FAIL)  <- graded final, D6RF9 R1
#   drift 300->2500 = 4.985e-08 = 0.307% of value, 0.797% of the margin above the floor (6.255e-06)
#   direction = monotone DECREASING (early stop at 300 reports a HIGHER value than 2500 -> conservative:
#     it CANNOT manufacture a PASS; a GATE FAIL rung stays GATE FAIL, a would-be PASS is not made easier).
#     to 3-4 sig figs -> R2's outer-loop settling tracks R1's; R2 was killed at ~250, just before its own
#     ~300 plateau, NOT diverging. (Honest caveat: R2/R3/R4 never completed, so their plateau at 300 is
#     EVIDENCED by R2's early tracking of R1 + the shared first-uncorrected mechanism, not directly measured
#     to endTime. B-300 measures whatever plateau each lever reaches, since the plateau is reached by ~300.)
